title: Print Two-Page Reader-Spread Layout For All Reports
description:
Turn all print reports (zwischenbericht, forschungsbericht, kompaktbericht, report/paper templates — not the flyer) into proper two-page reader-spread layouts so the PDF is printable by just enabling duplex/two-page printing.

Requirements:
- Book convention: page 1 (cover) stands alone, then spreads 2|3, 4|5, ... — odd pages recto (right), even pages verso (left).
- Insert an empty page after the cover so front matter starts on a recto.
- Page number and current part/chapter/section title chip always sit on the OUTER edge of the page: right on odd pages, left on even pages. This means mirroring both chrome bars (navbar heading chip, footer page-number chip) by page parity.
- Total physical page count must be a multiple of 4 (saddle-stitch ready) — pad with empty pages at the end.
- Add a gutter: inner margin wider than outer margin (binding offset), keep folio/text block clear of the outer trim.
- Flyer (type=flyer, landscape single sheet) is explicitly out of scope and stays oneside/unchanged.

Implementation plan (approved, see /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/print-turn-all-reports-clever-parrot.md):
1. print/tex/semio.cls — enable twoside + bindingoffset in the geometry \str_case for paper/report/fallback (not flyer); load scrreprt/scrartcl with twoside=true (report additionally open=right, cleardoublepage=empty).
2. print/tex/semio-window.sty — add a page-parity conditional (\Ifsemiochromemirrored) and use it inside \semio@chrome@bar@threezone's edge box so navbar heading chip and footer page-number chip swap sides by \ifodd\value{page}; fix chip inter-spacing (move trailing \hspace to be between-chip) in \semio_footer_logo_chip:n / \semio_footer_author_chips: so mirrored groups sit flush at the outer edge. Optionally delete the dead \semio@chrome@footer@shipout (never invoked).
3. print/tex/semio-components.sty — add \semio_clear_to_recto: helper (clearpage + conditional blank+empty-pagestyle page to land on a recto in twoside mode); use it in \makecoverpages (blank page after cover), \semio_maketitle: (plain \maketitle path), and \semio_mainmatter_begin: (replacing the bare \clearpage) so page 1 arabic always lands on a recto. Add an AtEndDocument pad-to-multiple-of-4 using a \AddToHook{shipout/before} physical page counter.

Verification: build all templates (bun print/script.ts build) and the real zwischenbericht (bun mit-bestand/bericht/script.ts build), then check with pdftotext/pdftotext -bbox: total physical pages % 4 == 0, blank verso after cover, arabic page 1 on odd physical page, folio/heading-chip x-position flips by parity, flyer output unchanged. Visual spot-check in two-page PDF view.
summary:
Removed the forced blank page after the cover/front page. Edited print/tex/semio-components.sty: deleted the `\semio_clear_to_recto:` call at the end of `\semio_maketitle:` (plain \maketitle path) and at the end of `\makecoverpages` (real cover). Front matter now starts on the physical page immediately following the cover, whatever its parity, instead of being forced onto a recto page with an inserted blank verso. `\semio_clear_to_recto:` itself is kept (still used by `\semio_mainmatter_begin:` to start main matter on a recto), as are the outer-edge chrome mirroring and the end-of-document pad-to-multiple-of-4.

Verified with a forced rebuild (`bun nx run @semio-tech/print:build --skip-nx-cache`, `bun nx run @semio-tech/mit-bestand-bericht:build --skip-nx-cache`), exit 0, no errors. Page 2 of the real zwischenbericht now shows the TOC ("Vorspann"/"Inhaltsverzeichnis") instead of being blank. All page counts remain multiples of 4: zwischenbericht 20 (was 24), forschungsbericht 24, report 12, paper 4, kompaktbericht 4; flyer unaffected at 2.
